digest.component_or_area: CLI guide delivery and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: Repo-less CLI clients encounter dangling internal cross-references in packaged guides because links use consumer-relative paths instead of hosted URLs or rebar explain commands
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) lacks a CLI-discoverable home; it exists only in rebar verify-commit-ticket help and verify_commit.py, with no offline guide topic
Packaged author guides in src/rebar/_guides/ must be relinked to resolve for clients without a rebar checkout using hosted github.com URLs or rebar explain <topic> conventions
A guard test must prevent regression by asserting no packaged guide markdown link targets are consumer-relative paths; only https://, http://, #anchor, or mailto: are allowed
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring hardcodes the guide list (plan/review) and must be updated to include commit-trailer so MCP clients discover it
Links within packaged guides to sibling guides must use rebar explain <topic>, and links to repo-only docs must use the canonical https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/ base URL
